scope: Independent trace-only review of M517; no production analyzer import, no EDA/VCS/GPU, no production evidence mutation

independent_reconstruction.method: Stream sealed tar.zst; select FC2 records independently from manifest; verify member size and SHA; reconstruct little-endian bit occupancy, modulo-8 bank maxima, full-vector and 96-bit-tile service floors

per_sample_stability.interpretation: The tiny high-density tail varies relatively, but its absolute population remains negligible in every sample; event and service-floor ledgers are stable.

fairness_ruling.proof: For each 96-bit tile, the sparse issue floor max(bank occupancy) is at most 12, exactly the dense sequential cost. For cross-tile vectors, max(sum bank counts) is at most sum(max tile bank counts), so preserving cross-tile aggregation only strengthens the sparse baseline.
fairness_ruling.boundary: A physically parallel dense engine with independent banks is a different resource point; M517 neither evaluates nor rules out such an area-matched design.

energy_ruling.reason: No matched SAIF/PTPX or SRAM access energy exists; M517 explicitly reports only access direction and omitted taxes.

p1.issue: The sentence that H67 FC2 lacks a meaningful high/low-density mix is broader than the measured gate supports.
p1.evidence: 978003 tiles (2.6809%) are at least 25% dense and carry 19.655% of events, although only 1922 reach 50%.
p1.required_change: Qualify the conclusion to the declared shared-eight-bank same-resource router. State that an independently provisioned parallel dense path was not evaluated.

p1.issue: The 118.651M segmented tile floor is not the strongest possible hybrid sparse schedule because an implementation could preserve aggregation among remaining sparse tiles.
p1.required_change: Use the per-tile dominance proof and 1.0x no-op result as the primary KILL argument; retain 118.651M only as the explicitly tile-segmented candidate outcome.

p1.issue: The uniform 1.0355-cycle/nonzero-tile attribution is not exact per-tile M216 accounting.
p1.required_change: Keep it labeled optimistic sensitivity only. Do not use it in a paper speedup table or energy claim.

p1.issue: The production M517 result directory is not yet a self-sealed receipt and the result does not bind the M517 decision contract SHA.
p1.required_change: Add a non-overwriting SHA256SUMS/RUN_COMPLETE receipt or outer seal that binds analyzer, contract, result, manifest and archive before archival use.

admit: Trace-only negative result: a shared-eight-bank per-96-bit dense/sparse FC2 router is KILL on frozen H67 ep35.
Exact frozen trace counts and density distributions reproduced independently.
No-op 1.0x is below the predeclared 1.10x RTL gate.
forbid: Any FC2, FFN or system speedup from M517
Any net energy saving from M517
A blanket claim that H67 cannot benefit from any area-matched dual-path architecture
Transfer of Bishop or FireFly-T published speedups
